description: This file defines an abstract class `DurableGrain` that provides implementation for managing durable state machines within the Orleans distributed application framework. It includes methods for obtaining or creating state machines and writing state asynchronously.

classes.name: DurableGrain
classes.description: An abstract class that manages durable state machines within a grain in Orleans, providing mechanisms to retrieve or create state machines and persist state asynchronously.

methods.name: DurableGrain
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the state machine manager and participates in the lifecycle if possible.

methods.name: GetOrCreateStateMachine
methods.description: Retrieves an existing state machine by name or creates a new one using a factory method.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Persists the state asynchronously, optionally accepting a cancellation token.
